Evidence / PSE-011
Evidence record
When was it measured or observed?21 May 2026

Dated remittance-agent licence suspension and closure event

01What does this evidence establish?

Governor's Decision No. 9 of 2026 of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden), dated 21 May 2026, suspends the licence of a remittance agent in Tuban, Lahj, and closes its premises. Later status, including any reinstatement, is not tracked here.

01What does this evidence establish?02What does it measure?03Who or what does it apply to?04How current is it?05What this evidence does not establish06Original source and verification07Method and verification detail

02What does it measure?

A dated licence suspension and closure ordered for one remittance agent by a Governor's decision of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden).

03Who or what does it apply to?

Only the remittance agent named in the decision.

04How current is it?

The decision is dated 21 May 2026. It does not describe the agent's status after that date; later decisions, including any reinstatement, are not tracked here.

05What this evidence does not establish

It does not establish the complete set of remittance agents, or the agent's later licence or operating status; later status, including any reinstatement, is not tracked here.
